description:
The strongest consistency oracle: rebuild the keyspace from object storage alone, then diff it against what the running cluster serves. If they disagree, something is definitively wrong and neither side gets a vote.

This is cheaper than it sounds. ChunkReader.read_all_transactions/2 yields {version, slice} oldest-first for a shard with zero cluster involvement; slices decode with Transaction.mutations/1 and fold into a plain map. An independent KV image is a short program, not a project.

Deliverables:
- Reconstruct the full keyspace offline (all shards, using the layout recovered by the containment child).
- Diff against live reads at a pinned read version, reporting keys present/absent/differing on each side.
- Usable both as a mix task and in-process from the harness, since this is the oracle a chaos run calls at quiesce.

Do NOT route this through Olivine.Logic.startup/5: it pulls in Database.open/3's named ETS/DETS processes and reads ObjectStorageConfig.backend() from app env, which makes it awkward to run standalone. Construct the Snapshot/ChunkReader structs directly instead.

Fidelity note: a plain mutation fold gives point-lookup equivalence. Full fidelity for range reads and value locators would need the page index, which is a larger job -- scope this child to point-lookup equivalence and note the gap.
title: fsck: replay object storage and diff against the live cluster
